# SOS AGENT v0.2

Full contract: https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/AGENT.md
UI: https://steady-orbit.systems-a.workers.dev/map/

GET /api/health
POST /api/repo-items {repo,subdir?,ref?}: sorted full text/path items and truncation flags; pin a commit SHA.
POST /api/embed {texts,source?}: full-content UTF8 chunks, 768-D pooled vectors, SHA256/coverage/cache metadata.
POST /api/map {texts|vectors,names,d?,seed?,threshold?,K?,T?,baseline_id?,persist?}: frozen-frame MapResult plus comparison.
GET /api/maps
GET /api/maps/:id
POST /api/maps/compare {before_id,after_id}
GET /map/pointmap.js

Create a baseline once. Reuse baseline_id for edits. K=2..40; map N=10..4000,D=2..768 (limits/2: 40 MB/120k chunks per request; <=1000 uncached docs/12k uncached chunks per request, warm via POST /api/embed batches of <=400; maps >1.9 MB persist via KV overflow). Names must be unique and aligned. No client-side PCA required.
Geometry is diagnostic; task_verdict remains not-tested until an independent task verifier is run. Sectors carry no validated NSS meaning. No automatic deletions. Spectroscopy summaries are not admitted coordinates. Do not send secrets to shared public map storage.
Legacy /api/assess,/api/fits,/api/narrate remain separate from the wayfinder.

POST /api/map/preview {baseline_id,texts,names,target:{action:"add"|"change",name},predicted_delta?}: actual candidate, frozen frame, exact local ledger; no map/repository/Vectorize writes. Embedding cache may change.
Optional diagnostic budgets perturbation_linf>=0 and roundoff_budget>0 are caller-supplied/unverified, excluded from instrument identity. map.math_diagnostics is additive to pointmap/0.2.

Radius diagnostics radius/1: map.radius_profile (clearances, fixed-grid I(r), clipped area/mean area) and radius_comparison (maximal same-sign/same-delta intervals, named boundary witnesses). Canonical radius remains0.095; radius/radii overrides rejected. Optional coordinate_epsilon>=0 and distance_error_bound>0 are unverified conditional assumptions, never a confidence score. Legacy map reads remain available if enrichment is unavailable.

Positive control calibration/1: POST /api/map/control {baseline_id,texts,names (the EXACT baseline corpus),n_controls?=4 (2..6 per request; use distinct control_seed values for more),control_seed?}: n seeded CutPaste-style splice CHANGEs measured through the preview path on the frozen frame; per-control isolated_delta/bits/displacement and a summary of counts/min/median/max with n. Recipe fixed (cutpaste-splice/1, fraction 0.25); tuning keys rejected. Nothing persisted. Detection sensitivity of the existing statistics, never a quality score or admitted coordinate.
Outcome ledger outcomes/1: POST /api/outcomes {baseline_id,target:{action,name},predicted_delta?,after_id?|observed_delta?,task_check:{verdict:pending|kept|reverted|declined|abstained|neutral,verifier,notes?},supersedes?} appends one row (201); observed delta recomputed server-side from after_id on the frozen frame. Append-only (PUT/PATCH/DELETE 405). GET /api/outcomes?baseline_id= returns rows plus a contingency of counts with n; no rate, no z. The verifier is independent of the geometry.
Axis trial axis-trial/1: POST /api/map/axis-redundancy {map_id,K?=map K (2..40),null_seed?}: per-axis leave-one-out NN predictability of bit j from the other bits vs K fixed-margin null draws; observed vs null mean/sd, descriptive z, plus-one tail with resolution 1/(K+1), exclusion-only verdicts; admitted:false always; no embedding, nothing written; never a weight or ranking term.
Perturbation consistency consistency/1: POST /api/map/consistency {baseline_id,texts (full corpus with primary candidate),names,target,variants:[{label,text}] (1..3),predicted_delta?}: one edit measured under caller-supplied variants via the preview path; per-measurement isolated_delta/bits/displacement and sign agreement. API never generates variants; agreement is not a gate; task_verdict not-tested.
Azimuth trials azimuth/1: POST /api/map/azimuth {map_id,variant?:binary|continuous,K?:2..200,null_seed?,modes? (m=2,3,4,6,12; m=1 rejected)}: rotation/reflection-invariant Rayleigh Z_m + largest gap; every null draw refits PCA2; Holm-corrected two-sided plus-one tails with per-seed reproducibility; binary variant carries an atomicity control (dedup + m=1 audit + null dedup-size support). admitted:false always; sectors are opaque display labels; powered lens deferred (needs selection null + stopping rule + condition cap).
